title: Agentic AI ROI: what the 2026 numbers say
takeaways: 64% of surveyed Indian tech leaders are piloting or running agentic AI.
Only 12% can show significant, measurable AI ROI.
Gartner expects over 40% of agentic projects cancelled by 2027.
Just 21% of firms have mature governance for autonomous agents.
Bought tools succeed about twice as often as internal builds.
source_note: Sources: ET CIO&Leader 2026; Gartner 2025; Deloitte 2026; MIT NANDA 2025
